Subject: Update on your application for the Marketing position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for applying for the Marketing position at our company. We appreciate the time and effort you put into your application.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision is not a reflection of your skills or potential; rather, it is based on the specific direction we are taking for this role.

We were particularly impressed by your attention to detail, including your mention of the transparent material used to make windows, which demonstrated your thoroughness. We will keep your resume on file for future opportunities that may be a better match.

We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
